name: otame4-work-skills
description: Practical Agent Skills for Japanese job hunting and career change: self-analysis, entry-sheet and resume review, interview preparation, company research, and offer decisions.

plugins.name: otame4-career
plugins.description: Taking stock of a work history as facts before any document is written: what was done in each period, the applicant's own role, and what each claim actually rests on. (1 skill)

plugins.name: otame4-documents
plugins.description: Entry sheets, rirekisho, and shokumu-keirekisho: drafting and review against the question asked, the evidence available, and the character limit. (1 skill)

plugins.name: otame4-research
plugins.description: Company research from primary and official sources with every claim dated and attributed, and close reading of a Japanese job posting's pay and requirements. (2 skills)

plugins.name: otame4-interview
plugins.description: Interview preparation that starts from the documents already submitted, and a debrief that turns what happened into what to fix before the next round. (2 skills)

plugins.name: otame4-offer
plugins.description: Offer decisions and leaving well: checking the conditions an employer has stated in writing, putting several offers on one basis, and planning the resignation and the move to a new employer. (3 skills)
